traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀνακάμπτειν αὐτὸν ἐπάταξεν τὴν Ἰδουμαίαν ἐν Γεβέλεμ
traditions.VUL: cum reverterétur capta Sýria in valle Salinárum ,
traditions.KJV: when he returned from smiting of the Syrians in the valley of salt , [ being ]

traditions.LXX: εἰς ὀκτὼ καὶ δέκα χιλιάδας .
traditions.VUL: cæsis decem et octo míllibus :
traditions.KJV: eighteen thousand [ men ] .

14.english_reference: And he put garrisons in Edom ; throughout all Edom put he garrisons

traditions.WLC: וַ יָּ֨שֶׂם בֶּ אֱד֜וֹם נְצִבִ֗ים בְּ כָל אֱדוֹם֙ שָׂ֣ם נְצִבִ֔ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔθετο ἐν τῇ Ἰδουμαίᾳ φρουράν , ἐν πάσῃ τῇ Ἰδουμαίᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: et pósuit in Idumǽa custódes , statuítque præsídium :
traditions.KJV: And he put garrisons in Edom ; throughout all Edom put he garrisons ,

14.english_reference: and all they of Edom became David ’s servants

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י כָל אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְ דָוִ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐγένοντο πάντες οἱ Ἰδουμαῖοι δοῦλοι τῷ βασιλεῖ ·
traditions.VUL: et facta est univérsa Idumǽa sérviens David ,
traditions.KJV: and all they of Edom became David ’s servants .

14.english_reference: And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went

traditions.WLC: וַ יּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת דָּוִ֔ד בְּ כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔσωσεν Κύριος τὸν Δαυεὶδ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐπορεύετο .
traditions.VUL: et servávit Dóminus David in ómnibus ad quæcúmque proféctus est .
traditions.KJV: And the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went .

15.english_reference: And David reigned over all Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖ד עַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Δαυεὶδ ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ ·
traditions.VUL: Et regnávit David super omnem Israel :
traditions.KJV: And David reigned over all Israel ;

15.english_reference: and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֣י דָוִ֗ד עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּ צְדָקָ֖ה לְ כָל עַמּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν ποιῶν κρίμα καὶ δικαιοσύνην ἐπὶ πάντα τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: faciébat quoque David iudícium et iustítiam omni pópulo suo .
traditions.KJV: and David executed judgment and justice unto all his people .

16.english_reference: And Joab the son of Zeruiah [ was ] over the host

traditions.WLC: וְ יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל הַ צָּבָ֑א
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰωὰβ υἱὸς Σαρουίας ἐπὶ τῆς στρατείας ,

traditions.KJV: And Joab the son of Zeruiah [ was ] over the host ;

16.english_reference: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud [ was ] recorder

traditions.WLC: וִ יהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἰωσαφὰτ υἱὸς Ἀχειὰ ἐπὶ τῶν ὑπομνημάτων ,

traditions.KJV: and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud [ was ] recorder ;

traditions.WLC: וְ צָד֧וֹק בֶּן אֲחִיט֛וּב וַ אֲחִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים

traditions.KJV: And Zadok the son of Ahitub , and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar , [ were ] the priests ;

traditions.WLC: וּ שְׂרָיָ֖ה סוֹפֵֽר
traditions.LXX: καὶ Ἀσὰ ὁ γραμματεύς ,
traditions.VUL: et Saraías , scriba :
traditions.KJV: and Seraiah [ was ] the scribe ;

18.english_reference: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada [ was over ] both the Cherethites and the Pelethites

traditions.WLC: וּ בְנָיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְ הַ כְּרֵתִ֖י וְ הַ פְּלֵתִ֑י

traditions.KJV: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada [ was over ] both the Cherethites and the Pelethites ;

18.english_reference: and David ’s sons were chief rulers

traditions.VUL: fílii autem David sacerdótes erant .
traditions.KJV: and David ’s sons were chief rulers .
